messages:
sienna: Heads up  courier left a large cake box and a small electronics parcel in the lobby for our 2pm visitor (Maya L.). Front desk says visitor sticker rolls are empty. Cake smells amazing, pls dont eat it yet :cake:
frontdesk: delivery note  tracking #CK-7735 at 13:12. cake box on bench, parcel on top. visitor stickers: 0 remaining. we have blank badge cards in supply closet.
carlos: I can dash down in 5 to make a handwritten badge and move the cake to the kitchen fridge. who wants a slice later? :raised_hands:
lina: please fridge it if possible, it's a tiered cake. also row D seat 4 will be used for Maya if Quiet Room 1 stays booked.
packages-bot: courier update: signature recorded as "Courier A". photo uploaded to records.
sienna: use a blue visitor card, write "Maya L." and staple to lanyard. if someone could place a sticky: "Maya L. - 2pm" on the box thatd be great.
carlos: badge made and stapled. cake moved to fridge K2 shelf 2. left sticky note "Maya L. - 2pm" and put parcel in locker 5. code:
```
5092
```
fridge temp logged.
frontdesk: kiosk low on paper too; opened an infra ticket for supplies. thanks @carlos. We'll greet Maya at 2pm and escort to row D seat 4.
sienna: amazing, thank you all. Ill grab a plate and napkins at 1:55. (reaction: :heart:)
file_notes: watercooler: visitor cake delivery, out of visitor stickers, handwritten badge, fridge storage, locker code
